sources.title: A multi-fidelity Bayesian neural operator for mechanics of spinodal metamaterial
sources.facts: Bayesian DeepONet low-fidelity predictor plus high-fidelity residual. Hybrid acquisition combines uncertainty and geometric diversity; uncertainty-only acquisition concentrated on lamellar structures. Predicts loading/unloading stress curves; no hard thermodynamic constitutive guarantee established in this read.
sources.limits: Microstructure response prediction, not inverse online material estimation; 50 MC forwards in reported uncertainty evaluation are not a demonstrated robot control latency.

sources.title: Material-embedding Physics-Augmented Neural Networks: A first application to constitutive law parameterization
sources.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
sources.access_limit: Publisher fulltext/HAL document access failed. HAL metadata was read but is not fulltext. Laboratory date differs from publisher issue year; publisher metadata retained.
sources.facts: Trainable low-dimensional material embeddings are concatenated with inputs at each dense layer. Shared weights and embedding-only adaptation provide a direct precedent for material-conditioned PANN. Synthetic isotropic hyperelastic datasets; real experimental validation presented as future work in abstract.
sources.limits: No full-method comparison, hyperparameters, or released implementation could be independently assessed.

sources.title: Neural operators solve inverse problems for constitutive model discovery
sources.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
sources.facts: PANO/CANO infer a hyperelastic energy function from full-field displacement and reaction-force data. Laplacian preprocessing plus positive branch coefficients and constrained trunk features. CANO uses six polynomial constitutive terms. 3000 synthetic simulations, 80/10/10 split.
sources.limits: Isotropic incompressible hyperelastic material, standardized geometry and protocol. Geometry transfer preserves specified shape ratios. Finite observations cannot uniquely identify an arbitrary energy function outside observed deformation ranges.

sources.title: Discovering uncertainty: Bayesian constitutive artificial neural networks
sources.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
sources.code_audit: BCANN directory confirmed; BCANN full source not read. Same repository GCANN partial source read under MAT05.
sources.facts: Probabilistic outer constitutive weights with deterministic internal features; variational NLL, KL and sparsity terms. Synthetic noisy/incomplete data and healthy/diseased arterial tests.
sources.limits: Distribution output is not automatically calibrated under robot deployment shift; exact recovery of constitutive coefficients is not implied by a good stress fit.

sources.title: Discovering uncertainty: Gaussian constitutive neural networks with correlated weights
sources.read_version: arxiv v1 methods/results, then published methods and discussion checked
sources.facts: Correlated Gaussian outer weights yield analytic stress means/variances with sparse constitutive features. Biaxial experiments are held out by curve rather than randomly scattered points.
sources.limits: Gaussian weights with nonzero variance cannot be nonnegative almost surely; Section 2.3 uses a probability bound. Positive-support alternatives lose the general exact Gaussian moment simplification.

sources.title: Adaptive Material Fingerprinting for the fast discovery of polyconvex feature combinations in isotropic and anisotropic hyperelasticity
sources.facts: Greedy residual correlation selects and scales positive energy features from a precomputed response database. Experimental rubber and anisotropic skin data, optional polyconvex feature filtering.
sources.limits: Adaptive means adaptive model combination, not time-varying physical material parameters; standardized measurement protocols and hyperelastic assumptions remain.

sources.title: Towards Rapid Constitutive Model Discovery from Multi-Modal Data: Physics Augmented Finite Element Model Updating (paFEMU)
sources.facts: Pretrain and sparsify a constitutive energy network, then update low-dimensional parameters using FE adjoint on full-field displacements and resultant force. Synthetic transfer across Gent-type, Neo-Hookean and Ogden behavior.
sources.limits: Relaxed monotonicity versions are not polyconvex by construction; observed Newton convergence does not prove global admissibility. Not an online foot-contact estimator.

sources.title: A dual-stage constitutive modeling framework based on finite strain data-driven identification and physics-augmented neural networks
sources.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
sources.facts: Data-Driven Identification produces strain/stress material states before PANN fitting, with finite-strain formulations and pseudo-stiffness choices. Numerical and synthetic-noise studies.
sources.limits: Not counted among six deep reads; full derivation and complete noisy-test outcomes not audited.

sources.title: A material-embedded physically recurrent neural network framework for surrogate-assisted multiscale modeling of composite structures
sources.access_limit: SSRN PDF fetch failed 403; no bypass attempted.
sources.facts: Material embeddings and multi-task recurrent constitutive models form path-dependent fictitious material points for PRNN/FE2 surrogate modeling.
sources.limits: Detailed loss/architecture, exact thermodynamic constraints and complete empirical claims not verified; do not claim our material-embedding recurrence is new.

sources.title: Unsupervised learning of history-dependent constitutive material laws with thermodynamically-consistent neural networks in the modified Constitutive Relation Error framework
sources.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
sources.facts: Dual ICNN potentials, modified Constitutive Relation Error learning from partial displacement/strain with uncertain boundary conditions; adaptive learning-rate/loss weighting for history-dependent models.
sources.limits: Full derivation, all algorithm settings and runtime not audited. Automatic training hyperparameters do not mean physically changing material parameters.
